inclusion_rule: Decoders that map silently articulated (mouthed, subvocal) non-acoustic signals to phoneme, word or sentence sequences, classified by the training-only target: text or phoneme labels of the silent utterance alone (HMM or CTC), or targets transferred from a parallel vocalized recording by time alignment (DTW). Any signal qualifies. Boundary: isolated-word closed-set classifiers, train-on-vocalized/test-on-silent studies without silent training data, imagined speech, and synthesis-only studies are outside the design comparison; pattern-match counts are upper bounds; versions count once.
